description: Machine-friendly NL2SQL guide for the M8 analytics-content module.

join_hints.name: content_indicator_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from analytics content to indicator thresholds.

join_hints.name: content_chart_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from analytics content to chart configuration.

join_hints.name: content_module_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from analytics content to module master data.

important_rules: Use m8_content for dashboard-content definitions and indicator formulas.
Use m8_indicator for thresholds/comparators, not for the main content formula.
Use m8_content_chart when the user asks for visualization or chart configuration.
m8_f_* tables are better treated as specific analytics metric/fact tables, not as general content masters.
M8 is primarily a readonly analytics-setup domain; avoid write paths unless the user explicitly asks about indicator maintenance.

query_patterns.name: content_catalog
query_patterns.pattern: Gunakan m8_content dan join ke m8_indicator bila perlu threshold.

query_patterns.name: chart_configuration_lookup
query_patterns.pattern: Gunakan m8_content_chart lalu join ke m8_content.

query_patterns.name: metric_specific_lookup
query_patterns.pattern: Gunakan tabel m8_f_* yang sesuai nama metric yang diminta user.

caution_areas: Pertanyaan yang mencampur master content dengan tabel metric spesifik tanpa tujuan jelas.
Pertanyaan yang menganggap m8_indicator menyimpan formula utama content.
Pertanyaan yang mencoba mengubah threshold/indicator padahal konteks user hanya analisis readonly.
